items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with Tank Bigsby and DeVonta Smith on Eagles final injury report.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice all week; official Friday report.
items.implication: Eagles RB/WR corps depleted; Hurts targets shift to Goedert/Wicks.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Sunday night vs Falcons (ankle).
items.why: Ankle sprain; no practice Wed/Thu; coach confirmed.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass game volume down; Falcons D streamable.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) with AD Mitchell also OUT for Jets.
items.why: Quad; second straight miss; Friday report.

items.implication: Daniels return but missing top WR; McLaurin Q.

items.text: Jayden Daniels IN/ACTIVE and will start; Rachaad White also IN.
items.why: Full practice; HC confirmed return from elbow.
items.implication: Commanders offense upgrades with Daniels back (Diggs out).

items.text: Quentin Johnston OUT; Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE for Chargers.
items.why: Chest for Johnston; foot for McConkey.
items.implication: Herbert targets concentrate on remaining WRs.
items.opportunity: Route/target share up for active Chargers pass-catchers.

items.text: Michael Pittman OUT multiple weeks (foot aggravated).
items.why: Plantar fasciitis re-aggravated; coach said multi-week.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN; not on final injury report despite ankle maintenance.
items.why: Limited practice but full-go comments; cleared final report.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role/workload this week despite ankle maintenance and prior Week 4 drag criticism; not on final report.
items.why: Fan/media pressure + cleared; accounts for downside but projects clear lead.
items.implication: RB2/FLEX upgrade; start with confidence if healthy.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins as WR8 vs Titans; volume + red-zone + matchup gift.
items.why: Target-hog volume including RZ; Titans struggle vs WRs.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown as RB5 @ MIA; gobbles targets/fantasy points; 'Brown Gobbler' nickname push; Bengals injury boost possible.
items.why: Workload + soft run D + potential Chase/Higgins absences.

items.text: Chris Olave listed IN with Noah Fant.
Malik Nabers multi-risk: knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) style; expressed frustration over low second-half targets.
items.implication: Monitor closely; volatility ROS despite talent.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle + matchup), Mark Andrews (TE17, Huntley/Lamar out impact), Cam Skattebo (RB20 efficiency/game script), Tony Pollard, Jalen Hurts (rough stretch + line).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, usage data, injuries (Lamar for Andrews), efficiency concerns.
items.implication: Fade/sit relative to ADP or alternatives.
